parameters.query:
UPDATE agent_runs
SET status = $2,
    extracted_data = $3::jsonb,
    error_message = $4,
    input_tokens = COALESCE(input_tokens, 0) + $5,
    output_tokens = COALESCE(output_tokens, 0) + $6,
    cost_usd = COALESCE(cost_usd, 0) + $7
WHERE id = $1
RETURNING id, status, extracted_data, cost_usd;

UPDATE agent_runs
SET proposed_action = $2::jsonb,
    status = $3,
    error_message = COALESCE($4, error_message)
WHERE id = $1
RETURNING id, status;

WITH moved AS (
  UPDATE agent_runs
  SET status = 'awaiting_approval'
  WHERE id = $1
    AND status = 'classified'
    AND message_id NOT LIKE 'eval-%'
  RETURNING id
)
INSERT INTO approvals (run_id, state, sent_at, expires_at)
SELECT id, 'pending', now(), now() + make_interval(hours => $2::int)
FROM moved
RETURNING id, run_id, expires_at;
